depths.beyondsolo.weather.clear.desc: The air in this gate is calm.
depths.beyondsolo.weather.mist.desc: A cold mist fills the cave. You can see only a few steps ahead.
depths.beyondsolo.weather.scorching.desc: The heat builds burns while you stay out of water.
depths.beyondsolo.weather.blizzard.desc: An icy wind cuts through the cave and the cold slows you down.
depths.beyondsolo.weather.storm.desc: Bolts of mana strike wherever the floor lights up. Keep moving.
depths.beyondsolo.weather.miasma.desc: Poison spores hang in the air. Venom builds up the longer you breathe them.
depths.beyondsolo.weather.crimson.desc: The creatures here hit harder and heal from every blow they land.
depths.beyondsolo.weather.darkness.desc: A darkness eats the light. You can barely see, and the creatures are quicker.
depths.beyondsolo.weather.tremors.desc: The cave shakes and rocks come down wherever the ground is marked.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.vault.desc: A sealed treasure room, untouched since the gate formed.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.enter.vault: Gold glints in the dark. The vault's cache is yours.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.shrine.desc: A quiet shrine. Step inside to receive its blessing.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.enter.shrine: A calm settles over you as you step inside.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.lair.desc: Something guards this chamber. Defeat its guardians to claim their hoard.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.enter.lair: Its guardians wake. Defeat them all to claim the hoard.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.found.title: Hidden dungeon found: %s
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.hollow: The wall sounds hollow. Knock again.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.lair_cleared.bo: Its guardians have fallen. Their hoard is yours.
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.blessing.title: Shrine's Blessing
depths.beyondsolo.hidden.blessing.body: Strength, regeneration and resistance for 5 minutes.
depths.beyondsolo.scan.found: Your pulse found something hidden nearby.
depths.beyondsolo.trap.lockdown.hint: The exits are sealed. Survive both waves.
depths.beyondsolo.trap.spikes.hint: Spikes burst from the marked floor. Break the core to stop them.
depths.beyondsolo.trap.vents.hint: Vents blast the marked floor. Break the core to stop them.
depths.beyondsolo.trap.rockfall.hint: Rocks fall on the marked spots. Break the core to stop them.
depths.beyondsolo.trap.done.title: %s cleared
depths.beyondsolo.trap.defused.title: %s disarmed
depths.beyondsolo.weakness.found.title: Weakness Found
